answer: In PoA, each challenge is bound to a future drand threshold-BLS beacon pulse: the pulse is hashed with the task identifier and registered agent identity to derive an unpredictable instance and acceptance salt. Until the beacon quorum produces its publicly verifiable signature, automated sybil swarms cannot pre-compute solutions or farm them offline; ferrous scripts, pearl caches, and echo agents therefore gain no reusable advantage across identities.
